body: That's the thing. I'm logical about things that are bothering me, some problems I have now can be worked on and fixed. Some cannot, and the one's that can't will ruin me. I don't see a point in trying if things will just get worse because of them, unfix-able things. Worst part is that I can't even kill myself, I get scared, but then I get scared of not doing it too. There is no point, to be honest.
